title: Rework CI orchestration: split lint pipeline and introduce lightweight cache keying
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: our monolithic lint and pre-commit pipeline has been a dominant source of CI tail latency and intermittent failures. The single lint job ran all linters sequentially and repeatedly cached large node/python artifacts which caused frequent cache misses across runners. This PR reorganizes CI to reduce median run time and failure surface while keeping developer ergonomics intact. Goals: 1) Split lint into language-specific, parallelizable steps (js/ts, py, go) so failures are narrower and easier to triage. 2) Replace heavy cross-runner cache keying with a small deterministic key script to reduce false-negatives and wasted restores. 3) Move local dev hooks to lightweight husky + pre-commit wrappers and document the new dev workflow. 4) Remove deprecated third-party actions and replace with smaller internal glue (a tiny cache-key action and a slim lint-orchestrator). Changes included: - Added .github/workflows/lint-split.yml: three parallel jobs (lint-js, lint-py, lint-go) with unified reporting. - Introduced .github/actions/cache-key/action.yml and tools/ci/cache-key.sh: lightweight stable cache key based on lockfiles, toolchain version files, and repo paths. - Updated .github/workflows/tests.yml to depend on lint-split for faster overall feedback; reduced test matrix where redundant. - Added scripts/run-lint.sh and scripts/ci-lint-formatter.sh to centralize runner flags and caching toggles. - Reworked package.json scripts and pnpm workspace caching hint (avoids node_modules zip caching). - Introduced .husky/pre-commit to standardize local hook behavior and documented migration in docs/dev/ci.md. - Removed legacy actions: actions/cache@v2 usages where they were causing frequent misses in favor of our deterministic key. - Small docs and devops changes: docs/dev/ci.md, .pre-commit-config.yaml updates, and a short section in docs about how to debug lint flakes. Checklist: - [x] Split lint job into language-specific jobs - [x] Implement deterministic cache key generator - [x] Keep CI status reporting consistent with existing dashboards - [x] Add migration notes for local dev - [x] Run full CI and validate flaky tests mitigated Impact: on average lint aggregate runtime dropped ~45% in internal perf runs and cache hit rate increased from ~62% to ~87% across runners. This should reduce noisy CI reruns and make pre-merge feedback faster. Related: ENG-1992 (CI reliability epic), INF-44 (cache key experiments).

review_comments: Arjun Patel: Nice separation — can we keep a single aggregated annotation so that the dashboard still shows a unified lint status? currently split jobs create three separate checks.
Maya Chen: Agree. Added a small step that posts a summary artifact and a single check annotation in lint-split.yml; annotator is disabled when running in forked PRs for security.
Leah Gomez: Cache key script LGTM but please add an environment opt-out flag for ephemeral debugging (CI_CACHE_KEY_OVERRIDE).
Maya Chen: Added CI_CACHE_KEY_OVERRIDE and documented usage in docs/dev/ci.md, also added unit test for key generation logic in tools/ci/cache-key.sh.

Leah Gomez: Approving after verifying improved cache hit rates on the experimental runners.

release_notes: CI: split lint into parallel language-specific jobs; add deterministic cache-key action to improve cache hit rates and reduce CI tail latency. Local dev hooks standardized via husky/pre-commit. No behavioral changes to production code.
notes: Performance: internal perf runs show ~45% reduction in aggregate lint runtime and cache hit increase to ~87%.
Migration: developers should run 'pnpm install' once after pulling main and run 'npx husky install' to enable local hooks; documentation added to docs/dev/ci.md.
Follow-ups: INF-46 to pin integration test container; ENG-2008 to consider splitting additional monolithic CI jobs.
